messages:
Rhea: Heads-up for Fri: two visitors coming — one will need a long-term guest badge (conference run-through), other is dropping off a package for Marcus and might need a ramp/accessible route. Also incoming package from 'Green Grove Flowers' scheduled 10:20. Anyone on desk duty?
Front Desk Bot: @Rhea 1: Guests can pre-register: https://redwood-internal/checkin. Note: long-term guest badges >1 day require a signed visitor form. Flowers and perishables are logged as "PACKAGE - CUST - Green Grove Flowers".
Leo: I9m desk duty Fri morning until 11:30. I can take care of badge printing and escorting. If the long-term guest wants access to the 4th floor, we need a temporary elevator fob; Facilities must approve.
Anika: I9ll ping Facilities now for the elevator fob. Also, Marcus, where should we sign the delivery for the flowers? Front desk or your team area?
Marcus: Put them at the front desk and text me010303-555-0199 when they arrive. I9ll pick them up on my way in. Also, FYI I have a personal package expected from Amazon PMD-3423 around 9am.
Front Desk Bot: Reminder: Front desk holds personal packages for 3 business days. Large packages (>30lbs) are moved to the loading dock and a notice is emailed. Guests without ID must be escorted by an employee at all times.
Rhea: Thanks Leo + Anika. @Facilities please confirm elevator fob by EOD. Also can someone bring a folding sign that says "Event delivery staging 10:00-12:00" so people don't clear the table?
Leo: I9ll bring a small A-frame sign from storage. Marcus 02:45pm, can you confirm if the package needs refrigeration? Flowers yes, but the other parcel is just tech accessories.
Marcus: Flowers only need water, no fridge. Tech box is fine at room temp.
Anika: Facilities confirmed the fob request; they need a host name for the sign-out form. Rhea, can you put the guest name in the calendar invite?
Rhea: Done. Calendar invite updated with guest name, arrival instructions (Entrance B, ring buzzer, call host), and a note: "needs accessible route".
Front Desk Bot: Log entry created: DELIVERY - Green Grove Flowers - expected 10:20 Fri - hold at desk. TEMP BADGE NOTE: If a temp badge is lost, reissue requires ID and sign-out of previous badge.
Leo: All set from my side. If anyone wants me to show the guest the lactation room or quiet room, I can add that to the escort tour.
Marcus: Appreciate it. Rhea 1: I9ll DM the florist to confirm delivery window.
Rhea: Thanks team. If Facilities confirms the sign + fob by EOD, I9ll close this thread. :thumbsup:
